install: node -v && python3 --version && python3 -c 'import json, pathlib, re, subprocess; html = pathlib.Path("index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8"); js = re.findall(r"<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)(?![^>]*\btype=[\x27\"]application/ld\+json[\x27\"])[^>]*>(.*?)</script>", html, flags=re.S | re.I); ld = re.findall(r"<script[^>]*\btype=[\x27\"]application/ld\+json[\x27\"][^>]*>(.*?)</script>", html, flags=re.S | re.I); assert js, "No inline JS scripts found"; [subprocess.run(["node", "--check"], input=s, text=True, check=True) for s in js]; [json.loads(s) for s in ld]; print(f"Verified {len(js)} inline JS blocks and {len(ld)} JSON-LD blocks")'
